findings.problem: The hint rules out bare que, but el que and el cual are also correct after con here (con el que vivo, con el cual vivo), and the learner could read not que as allowing el que.
findings.fix: hint: one-word relative pronoun for a person after a preposition, not el que or el cual; no accent

back.es: who / whom (relative pronoun for a person, used after a preposition)
back.example: She is the girl with whom I talked (She's the girl I talked to).

note: The friend in the prompt has no gender, so a hint naming el que and el cual covers la que and la cual too.
